title: Borrowing limits
answer: Members can borrow up to three tools at a time. The standard loan lasts seven days.

title: Returning tools
answer: Return tools to the staffed desk during opening hours. Bring any accessories listed on the loan slip.

title: First-visit orientation
answer: New members complete a 20-minute orientation before borrowing powered tools. Ask the help desk about the next session.

title: Opening hours
answer: The tool library opens Tuesday and Thursday from 4 to 8 p.m. and Saturday from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.

title: Weekend locker trial
answer: The draft proposes weekend locker pickup for reserved kits. The service has not been approved.
